title: BlackLanturn 1.1.28
summary: Direct update access, clearer completion and easier genre navigation.

sections.heading: Easier updates
bullets: Update from a BlackLanturn notification opens your installed build update confirmation directly.
After a successful update, Close Kodi is selected. Close later remains available; reopen Kodi after closing.
Older BlackLanturn update prompts also use the in-place updater.

sections.heading: Genre navigation
bullets: Choose genre now follows Details in main Movies and Shows Options.
Genre choices stay hidden while browsing episodes and seasons.

sections.heading: Consistent Details artwork and previews
bullets: Details artwork and previews now use the same compact hero area and soft edge fades as other previews.
An unavailable update catalog shows a retry message and leaves your setup unchanged.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Included add-ons, Installer and tested patches update together through Update BlackLanturn.
Settings, accounts, playback preferences, sources, watched progress and unrelated add-ons remain in place.
